baseline.rootCause: A connected prepared console is not yet a fully loaded/authenticated/desktop-bound native input/release pair. Movement-triggered preparation after the fixed 3s expiry is too late for short idle reentry.

changes: Each native input/release child reports five local startup spans through fixed KRD8 diagnostics: installation/self validation, service authentication/image adoption, agent authentication, parent validation and initial desktop entry. OS loader time before Go entry is not attributed to a measured span.

One clean ordinary lease return creates one delayed construction opportunity at 3s. Retain any live initial spare until its exact original expiry, then retire it before constructing once. Physical hint/input take/shutdown supersedes the opportunity; cancellation, expired lease and cleanup uncertainty fence it.

validation.go: Full go test ./... -timeout=120s passed with CGO_ENABLED=0 and deployment offlineGo runtime overlay.
validation.regression: Disabling the delayed opportunity reproduces a failing 5s reentry regression; the fixed behavior passes. One-shot/cooldown, exact expiry, input/hint/shutdown/cancel/lease cancellation and uncertain retirement checks passed.
validation.frontend: Frontend tests and native production build passed in build-workspace.ps1.
validation.package: Workspace archive, icons, native installer and offline setup verification passed.
validation.installation: Both setup results 0, recovery not_needed; matching g503 UI/agent/installed build evidence, protected input READY and authenticated CONNECTED.
validation.race: Skipped: CGO disabled in the deployment environment.

scope: Installation/startup snapshot only. The g503 physical latency effect and recovery recurrence require the next user crossing trial.
tradeoff: One additional unused three-process candidate may be built after each clean ordinary return; no periodic refresh. Longer idle and first-ever entry can still need movement-triggered preparation.
apiChanges: Fixed local KRD8 startup diagnostic envelope; network input protocol and public API unchanged.
